=== NEXUS SHORT DESCRIPTION (<=350 chars) ===

[EN] (298 chars)
Every race gets 2-3 new passives, and a slider to decide how strong they are. Open the menu with F1, drag a race anywhere from 0 to 200%. Think Nords should shrug off more frost? Crank it. Feel something's overtuned? Turn it down or off. Only adds new records, so it won't fight your other race mods.

[ZH]
给每个种族加 2-3 个被动，强度用游戏内滑条自己定。F1 打开菜单，0 到 200% 随便拖。想让诺德更抗冻？拉满。觉得哪个种族太强？调低或关掉。只新增记录，不跟其他种族 mod 打架。
